# `role`

Tenant role: a named set of permissions. System role templates (RBAC-01) are not seeded yet.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | aggregate-root |
| Tenant scope | Tenant scoped: `tenant_id` + row-level security, composite keys/FKs |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `created_at` |
| Retention class | `identity-access`: Access records kept for security review after revocation. Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | /v1/roles (planned) |
| Write path | platform repository createRole. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0002_identity_org (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (tenant_id, id)
- unique (tenant_id, lower(name))
- parent_role_id FK within the same tenant, not self
- is_system cannot be set by runtime roles
- optimistic version
- audit required
